# E-learning: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Course completion records must be kept for five years under the Training Standards Act (traced to US-6). |

## Backlog

US-1 As a learner, I want to take a quiz after each module so that I check my understanding.
US-2 As an admin, I want to enrol a team in a course so that they start together.
US-3 As a learner, I want to resume a lesson where I stopped so that I save time.
